title: DraftSR
description: Contract 2 (FlowDesk Chat V2). The live draft service request — the SOLE session-state carrier (CODEX-RULE-075). Persisted in Redis with TTL, read at turn start and written at turn end. On submit it is materialized into Memgraph. On escalation it is packaged with the transcript for Tier 1. Bound to a SchemaSnapshot via serviceId + schemaVersion.

schemaVersion.description: SchemaSnapshot.version this draft was created against. Pins interpretation.

userId.description: F10d. The user who owns this draft — used to find their parked drafts for resume (ADCC-098).

slots.description: Filled slots keyed by SchemaSnapshot slotId.

patches.description: Append-only patch journal. Every mutation is recorded for audit and provenance replay.

intentTrace.description: Ordered trace of intent classifications across turns (drift detection + training data).

dialogueStack.description: F10b/ADCC-080. Stack of open dialogue sequences (top = current pending question). First-class session state that survives across turns so the deterministic REPAIR_ROUTER (ADCC-081) can interpret the next utterance relative to what is open, instead of classifying it in isolation.

repair.description: F10c/ADCC-086. Repair attempt counters that drive the universal repair ladder and handoff escalation.

perSlot.description: Failed-understanding attempts per slotId (reset when the slot is successfully filled).

session.description: Session-wide failed-understanding attempts; crossing the handoff threshold offers a human.

pendingAction.description: F10c/F10d. A yes/no (or small-choice) confirmation the agent is awaiting: cancel / restart / skip-offer / handoff / mid-flow intent switch (ADCC-084) / resume a parked draft (ADCC-098). The next affirmative, negative or choice resolves it deterministically before the REPAIR_ROUTER.

serviceId.description: confirm_switch: the service the user is proposing to switch to.

message.description: confirm_switch: the original utterance that proposed the switch, replayed if the user accepts.

lastAgentQuestion.description: F10c/ADCC-096. The last question the agent asked, stored verbatim so the 'repeat' universal action can re-issue it exactly.

srNumber.description: Set once status=submitted. The materialized SR reference number.

transcriptRef.description: Pointer to the conversation transcript, attached on escalation.

sequenceId.description: Stable id of this open sequence.

type.description: What kind of sequence is open. slot_question = a slot value is being solicited.

slotId.description: For slot_question: the SchemaSnapshot slotId being asked.

openedAt.description: ISO timestamp the sequence was opened.

repairCount.description: Per-sequence repair attempts, drives the repair ladder / escalation (ADCC-086).

repairStep.description: Current rung on the universal repair ladder (ADCC-085): 0 targeted re-ask → 4 human handoff.

value.description: The filled value. Type per SchemaSnapshot slot.type.

provenance.description: How the value was obtained. Precedence for overwrite protection: user_edited is never overwritten by extracted (CODEX-RULE-075 invariant).

source.description: Optional origin detail (e.g. resolver token, extractor node id).

display.description: SCH-004. What the DICTIONARY said, when the stored value is a key rather than a label. Altiora composes a row's display from its columns (formatLinkedDictionaryParts); the key alone is a number where the reader expects a name, and it is the confirmation summary — the last thing seen before a request is sent — that shows it. Captured at resolution because nothing later can recover it without asking the dictionary again.

stale.description: True when a slot this value dependsOn changed after this value was set — must be re-confirmed before submit.

pending.description: Directory-backed slots (F9.1d): value is a provisional resolver default awaiting user confirm-or-choose. Treated as not-yet-filled until confirmed.

hint.description: Raw user mention used to resolve a directory-backed slot (e.g. the typed name/query). Not the final value.

rejected.description: True when the patch was recorded but not applied (e.g. extracted tried to overwrite user_edited).
